name: cloud-based-load-balancing-framework
description: Cloud-Based Load Balancing Framework - Academic Computer Networks Project

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.servers: concurrently -n "S1,S2,S3" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run server:s1" "npm run server:s2" "npm run server:s3"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "LB,UI,S1,S2,S3" -c "blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run server:s1" "npm run server:s2" "npm run server:s3"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix servers
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix servers
